about.title: Our Story
about.paragraph1: Alièfè was born from a passion for Ivorian gastronomy and the art of sharing food. Based in Casablanca, our mission is to introduce the authentic flavors of Côte d'Ivoire through dishes prepared with care, fresh produce and traditional know-how.
about.paragraph2: Every event — wedding, birthday or seminar — becomes a warm, unforgettable moment, where your guests travel to the heart of Ivorian flavors, as if they were back home.
about.missionText: Offering an authentic, elegant culinary experience.
about.visionText: Becoming the reference for upscale Ivorian catering in Morocco.

install.guideSubtitle: Add Alièfè to your home screen in a few seconds, no app store needed.
install.iosNotice: Do this from Safari (not Chrome) on iPhone or iPad.
install.iosStep1Text: The "Add to Home Screen" option only exists in Safari, not in Chrome or another app.
install.iosStep2Text: The icon with an upward arrow, at the bottom of the screen (or top on iPad).
install.iosStep3Text: Scroll through the options if needed, then tap it.
install.iosStep4Text: Top right of the screen. The Alièfè icon appears right away.
install.androidNotice: Do this from Chrome on your Android phone.
install.androidStep1Text: Installation happens directly from the browser, no app store needed.
install.androidStep3Text: Or "Add to Home screen" depending on your Chrome version.
install.androidStep4Text: The Alièfè app appears on your home screen just like a native app.
install.outro: Once installed, open the Alièfè icon: the app launches full-screen, with no browser bar.
